rows.definition: The post-fire reconciliation signal (#2791): a compaction that FIRED - which by construction proves the protected prefix was spliced byte-identically, since verifySplicedBody turns any byte-inequality into a prefix_mismatch identity return - yet whose provider reported zero cache_read and nonzero cache_creation, evidencing the provider re-created the very prefix fak preserved (a TTL expiry or capacity eviction fak cannot prevent).
rows.distinction: NOT CacheBreakEvent: that is a WITNESSED break fak itself authored and can see in its own splice verdict. SilentCacheInvalidation is the provider breaking a prefix fak PROVED it preserved - invisible to bytes.Equal, hence silent. Also NOT the #2785 induced-creation burst: a head-anchored fire bursts the recent suffix on purpose but still READS its protected head, so its cache_read stays positive and it is excluded here.

rows.definition: The closed three-rung vocabulary (VRAM/L2/NVMe) naming where a routed expert's weights live, mapped onto the pkg/moecache tier names.
rows.distinction: Names the TIER a routed expert resides on, not a residency plan (ExpertCachePlan) or a batch-admission result: it is the enum a policy transitions between, not a plan or a trace.

rows.definition: The session-level, tier-shaped fold of the device ring ledger, the checkpoint-tier ledger and the explicit L2 tier policy's transition counters, one counter block per rung.
rows.distinction: FOLDS per-rung traffic and transition counters into one three-tier record; unlike ExpertRingStats or ExpertCheckpointStats it is not one rung's own ledger, and unlike ExpertCachePlan it carries no admission decision.

rows.definition: The record of ONE expert tier transition: the from/to rungs, whether a promotion or demotion happened, how many candidates a demotion pass preserved because they were pinned, and why.
rows.distinction: Records a SINGLE transition decision with its reason, whereas ExpertTierStats aggregates many into counters; it is an event, not a running ledger of the whole tier.

rows.definition: The aligned read geometry of one NVMe expert fault: the alignment granularity plus the start/end and byte length a fault's unaligned range rounds to, stated without issuing the read.
rows.distinction: States the ALIGNED SPAN a fault would move (round-down start, round-up end) as pure geometry, rather than naming a page-cache entry or modeling the page cache that serves it.

rows.definition: The #1302 page-cache-aware expert read: reads one expert's stride through a mapped region, serving a warm fault zero-copy and issuing an aligned device ReadAt only on a cold fault.
rows.distinction: Names the READ OPERATION (one expert's bytes, warm-from-mapping vs cold-aligned-device) rather than a page-cache entry, a slot count, or the byte floor a page cache must clear to pay for itself.

rows.definition: inkling2PrefixCacheFromEnv reads FAK_INKLING2_PREFIX_SLOTS (how many resident Inkling-2 device sessions fak serve keeps warm for prefix reuse, default 1, capped at 8) and FAK_INKLING2_PREFIX_CACHE_MIB (the device bytes more than one slot may hold together, default 4096).
rows.distinction: The per-request resident-session slot pool of fak serve, keyed by prompt prefix and evicted LRU on device memory - not Inkling2BatchPrefixCacheMiB (the host-side cross-request store batch cohorts restore rows from) and not the generic prefixcache.

rows.definition: Inkling2BatchPrefixCacheMiB reports the host MiB FAK_INKLING2_BATCH_PREFIX_CACHE_MIB gives the Inkling-2 batch cohort cross-request prefix store and whether that turns it on, refusing a malformed value or a store cohorts could never use because cohort prefill is off.
rows.distinction: The host-memory prefix store that batch cohorts restore a row's KV from mid-prompt - not inkling2PrefixCacheFromEnv (the device-resident session slot pool of scalar serve) and not the generic prefixcache.

rows.definition: loadInkling2LoopModel is fak serve's loader stage for an inkling2-family GGUF: it claims the load for the dedicated looped forward (CUDA free-VRAM bound or the native resident Metal target), refuses a backend without that forward, and hands the native chat planner to the gateway.
rows.distinction: The serve-side load stage that claims an inkling2_loop GGUF - not inkling2loop-model (the in-memory looped model it produces) and not loop-inkling2-loopconfig (the per-model loop depth config it reads).

rows.definition: Selects and creates the Go build-cache directory for a bounded Windows command. The ordinary per-user cache is preferred, with a fallback directory under the coding workspace.
rows.distinction: Chooses the filesystem path. enforceGoCacheEnv passes the chosen path to the child process.

rows.definition: Replaces GOCACHE in a bounded Go child environment with the directory selected by the native agent.
rows.distinction: Builds the child environment. ensureWindowsGoCacheDir owns path selection and directory creation.

rows.definition: The resolved Go build cache directory supplied to gitdaily.Options for cache maintenance. An empty option disables that lifecycle.
rows.distinction: The bounded Windows command passes its selected directory to enforceGoCacheEnv. Only the gitdaily option configures cache maintenance.
